subject: Reschedule: EnterpriseBank demo — add CTO/VP sponsor

Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@enterprisebank.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Demo request — week of Jun 14

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — we are excited to see Redwood next week. Our CTO, Ravi Patel, just asked to join the demo if possible; he prefers mornings PT but can be flexible a bit. We have a site visit on Monday morning (Jun 14) which makes the early window tight.

Current constraints:
- Monday (Jun 14): site visit 8:30–12:00 PT, available after 1:30 PM PT
- Tuesday (Jun 15): generally available mornings 9:00–11:30 PT

Would you be able to shift the demo to Tue morning (Jun 15) or Mon afternoon? If Ravi can join, we want the technical/architecture segment to be early so he can ask questions before our afternoon leadership sync.

Also, could you include a brief mutual action plan and the deck ahead of time? We’ll share any pre-reads with Ravi.

Thanks — Aisha
Aisha Karim
Director, Cloud Platforms
EnterpriseBank

Hi Aisha — great question and thanks for the heads up about Ravi. We can absolutely accommodate the CTO joining. Laura (CS) and Jonas (Solutions Eng) will cover the technical/arch deep-dive.

Proposed slots that align with Ravi's morning preference:
- Tue, Jun 15 — 11:00 AM PT (45–60 min; we can start with architecture + integrations)
- Wed, Jun 16 — 9:00 AM PT (45–60 min)

If Tue 11:00 AM PT works, we’ll move forward and send an updated calendar invite (include Ravi) and I’ll attach the deck + mutual action plan for prep.

Attachments I’ll include: redwood_demo_deck.pdf (high-level + integrations) and EnterpriseBank_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf (timeline and owners).

Let me know which slot you prefer and who else from your side should be on the invite.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
